title: GoldenDB 108条日常运维SQL集锦 - 刘子毅
contentFull:
一、巡检与告警（1–27）
1. CN/DN SQL Digest 目录覆盖与更新时间——确认 CN、DN 两个来源是否有 SQL 摘要目录记录。
SELECT schema_name, type AS source_type,
       COUNT(*) AS digest_entries,
       MAX(last_update_time) AS newest_catalog_update
FROM goldendb_insight.gdb_sql_schema_static
GROUP BY schema_name, type
ORDER BY digest_entries DESC, schema_name
LIMIT 100

2. CN 在线事务时长与状态——查看 CN 上报的在线事务状态、时长和 SQL 数量。
SELECT cluster_id, cn_id, uuid, gtid, trans_state, trans_type, execute_time, start_time, executed_sql_num, executing_sql_num
FROM goldendb_statistic.insight_cn_trans_info
WHERE cluster_id = :cluster_id
ORDER BY execute_time DESC, cn_id LIMIT :row_limit

3. CN 消息状态采样——查看 CN 组件消息队列状态与线程描述。
SELECT time_stamp, cluster_id, device_id, device_type, connect_port, cn_msg_queue_status, pname_info
FROM goldendb_insight.gdb_cn_thdmsg
WHERE cluster_id = :cluster_id AND time_stamp >= :begin_time AND time_stamp < :end_time
ORDER BY time_stamp DESC, device_id LIMIT :row_limit

4. DN 在线事务与等待锁线索——定位 DN 在线事务、等待锁和潜在阻塞者。
SELECT cluster_id, group_id, dn_id, trans_id, uuid, gtid, trans_state, trans_type, execute_time, start_time, requested_lock_id, wait_start_time, block_trans_id, blk_trx_count
FROM goldendb_statistic.insight_dn_trans_info
WHERE cluster_id = :cluster_id
ORDER BY execute_time DESC, dn_id LIMIT :row_limit

5. DN 文件 I/O 等待历史采样排行——比较历史采样时点的文件 I/O 热点。
SELECT device_id, Event_Name, time_stamp, Request_Read, Request_Write, Bytes_Read, Bytes_Write, Time_Read, Time_Write FROM goldendb_statistic.gdb_dn_iowait_orderedbytime_awr WHERE cluster_id = :cluster_id AND time_stamp >= :begin_time AND time_stamp < :end_time ORDER BY Time_Read + Time_Write DESC LIMIT 50

6. DN 等待事件历史采样排行——回看等待事件次数、总等待与平均等待。
SELECT device_id, events, time_stamp, waits, `time`, avg_wait_time FROM goldendb_statistic.gdb_dn_wait_orderbytime_awr WHERE cluster_id = :cluster_id AND time_stamp >= :begin_time AND time_stamp < :end_time ORDER BY `time` DESC LIMIT 50

7. DN 等待会话及表刷新、元数据锁等待采样——分别展示等待表刷新和元数据锁的会话数。
SELECT device_id, time_stamp, dn_session_waiting_for_count, dn_session_waiting_for_table_flush_count, dn_session_waiting_for_table_mdl_count FROM goldendb_insight.gdb_processlist WHERE cluster_id = :cluster_id AND time_stamp >= :begin_time AND time_stamp < :end_time ORDER BY time_stamp DESC LIMIT 50

8. DN 锁冲突、缓冲区与 Redo 压力采样——同节点趋势线索，覆盖锁冲突率、脏页、命中率、临时表、Binlog 与 Redo。
SELECT device_id, device_type, group_id, db_role, time_stamp,
       tablelock_conflictrate, rowlock_avgwaittime, buffer_dirtypagerate,
       buffer_hitrate, filetemptable_usedrate, binlogdisk_usedstat, redolog_waitstat
FROM goldendb_insight.gdb_db_statistic
WHERE cluster_id = :cluster_id AND time_stamp >= :begin_time AND time_stamp < :end_time
ORDER BY time_stamp DESC LIMIT 50;

9. GTM 活跃 GTID 数与最大标识采样——观察全局事务标识变化。
SELECT time_stamp, cluster_id, device_id, device_type, activegtid, maxgtid
FROM goldendb_insight.gdb_gtm_gtidinfo
WHERE cluster_id = :cluster_id AND time_stamp >= :begin_time AND time_stamp < :end_time
ORDER BY time_stamp DESC, device_id LIMIT :row_limit

10. GTM 申请、释放与增量同步 GTID 平均耗时——定位分布式事务协调阶段的时间波动。
SELECT device_id, time_stamp, gtidapplycost, gtidreleasecost, gtidincrementcost FROM goldendb_insight.gdb_gtmgtid_timecost WHERE cluster_id = :cluster_id AND time_stamp >= :begin_time AND time_stamp < :end_time ORDER BY time_stamp DESC LIMIT 50

11. GTM 线程消息状态采样——查看 GTM 消息队列状态原值。
SELECT time_stamp, cluster_id, device_id, device_type, gtm_msg_queue_status, pname_info
FROM goldendb_insight.gdb_gtm_thdmsg
WHERE cluster_id = :cluster_id AND time_stamp >= :begin_time AND time_stamp < :end_time
ORDER BY time_stamp DESC, device_id LIMIT :row_limit

12. Insight 参数比对任务状态与基线——定位参数比对未执行或失败的任务。
SELECT task_id, cluster_id, task_type, device_type, status, create_time, template_id FROM goldendb_insight.insight_param_comparison_task ORDER BY task_id DESC LIMIT 50

13. Insight 参数配置或内存值不一致候选——找出配置值与内存值不一致的记录。
SELECT task_id, param, type, consistency, memory_consistency, repeat_time, memory_repeat_time, create_time FROM goldendb_insight.insight_param_comparison_result WHERE consistency = 1 OR memory_consistency = 1 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 50

14. Insight 巡检任务类型、目标范围与状态——区分实时、定时、历史范围巡检及任务状态。
SELECT id, task_name, patrol_type, patrol_object, status, start_time, patrol_interval FROM goldendb_insight.insight_patrol_task ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 50

15. Insight 日志采集未完成与部分成功任务——对比计划节点数与成功/失败数。
SELECT task_id, task_operate_status, collect_point_size, collect_success_size, collect_fail_size, create_time, end_time FROM goldendb_insight.insight_log_collect_task WHERE task_operate_status IN (1,2,3,4) LIMIT 50

16. Insight 管理账号登录失败与锁解事件——排查管理面无法登录或任务无法发起。
SELECT user_id, update_date, mod_type, m_trigger FROM goldendb_insight.insight_credential_user_log WHERE mod_type IN (1,2,4) ORDER BY update_date DESC, id DESC LIMIT 50;

17. Insight 组件升级编排任务状态——区分待执行、运行、成功与失败任务。
SELECT task_id, upgrade_create_time, upgrade_start_time, upgrade_end_time, upgrade_version, upgrade_servertype, task_type, task_status, upgrade_batch, upgrade_progress FROM goldendb_insight.insight_upgrade_task ORDER BY task_id DESC LIMIT 50

18. MDS 保存的表重分布容量参考——重分布前读取表在节点/组上的大小。
SELECT cluster_id,group_id,ip,master,table_name,table_size,insert_time FROM goldendb_omm.gdb_data_redistribute_tablesize_info WHERE table_name=:table_name ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT :row_limit;

19. MDS 告警事件及字典解释 Top 50——关联告警码、类型、等级、状态字典。
SELECT a.id,a.systype,ty.sysdesc AS alarm_type,a.alarm_code,cd.alarm_desc,a.alarm_level,lv.level_desc,a.alarm_status,st.status_desc,a.alarm_source,a.alarm_time,a.recovery_time FROM goldendb_insight.insight_alarm_info AS a LEFT JOIN goldendb_insight.insight_alarm_code AS cd ON cd.alarm_code=a.alarm_code LEFT JOIN goldendb_insight.insight_alarm_status AS st ON st.status_code=a.alarm_status LEFT JOIN goldendb_insight.insight_alarm_level AS lv ON lv.alarm_level=a.alarm_level LEFT JOIN goldendb_insight.insight_alarm_systype AS ty ON ty.systype=a.systype ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT 50

20. MDS 告警码、阈值与开关原��——盘点告警码目录及阈值、开关。
SELECT c.systype,ty.sysdesc AS alarm_type,c.alarm_code,c.alarm_desc,c.alarm_level,lv.level_desc,c.threshold,c.isopen FROM goldendb_insight.insight_alarm_code AS c LEFT JOIN goldendb_insight.insight_alarm_level AS lv ON lv.alarm_level=c.alarm_level LEFT JOIN goldendb_insight.insight_alarm_systype AS ty ON ty.systype=c.systype ORDER BY c.systype,c.alarm_code LIMIT 100

21. MDS 告警记录时间线——按短时间窗查看告警代码、级别、资源及清除时间。
SELECT alarmid, code, almlevel, resourcetype, resourceid,
       createtime, updatetime, cleartime, maskflag
FROM goldendb_omm.gdb_alarming
WHERE createtime >= :begin_time AND createtime < :end_time
ORDER BY createtime DESC
LIMIT 50

22. MDS 备份恢复等任务的组件步骤、重试和进度——定位未完成或失败组件。
SELECT stream_no, task_id, task_type, component_type, task_redo_times, task_state, task_step, task_sub_step_total, task_sub_step_current, task_start_time, task_end_time, task_progress_percentage, is_total_progress FROM goldendb_omm.gdb_task_progress_detail WHERE task_state IN (1,2,4) LIMIT 50

23. MDS 指定集群 DN 同步与 Relay 日志时延原值——定位复制追赶。
SELECT time_stamp, cluster_id, group_id, device_id, device_type,
       group_switching, db_role,
       sync_log_delay_time, sync_log_gap,
       relay_log_delay_time, relay_log_gap
FROM goldendb_insight.gdb_db_stat_delay_info
WHERE cluster_id = :cluster_id
  AND time_stamp >= :begin_time AND time_stamp < :end_time
ORDER BY time_stamp DESC, group_id, device_id
LIMIT 200

24. MDS 指定集群状态与运行模式——读取集群模式、运行状态和最近元数据更新时间。
SELECT CLUSTER_ID, CLUSTER_NAME, CLUSTER_MODE, CLUSTER_STATE, STATUS, WORK_MODEL, TIME_STAMP FROM mds.cluster_info WHERE CLUSTER_ID = :cluster_id;

25. MDS 按分片记录的 UNDO 日志使用量——发现持续升高的分片。
SELECT device_id, group_id, time_stamp, undo_log_size FROM goldendb_insight.gdb_undolog_size WHERE cluster_id = :cluster_id AND time_stamp >= :begin_time AND time_stamp < :end_time ORDER BY time_stamp DESC LIMIT 50

26. MDS 按日聚合的告警状态与等级数量 Top 100——观察告警趋势。
SELECT `aggretime`, `alarm_status`, `alarm_level`, `alarm_number`
FROM goldendb_insight.insight_alarm_info_day
ORDER BY `aggretime` DESC, `alarm_level`, `alarm_statu
